title: Helicopter Miami Grand Tour
includes: Bose A30 Headsets with Noise Cancellation System
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Break the routine. Go beyond the expected.

This 40 minute helicopter adventure gives you front-row views of Miami’s most iconic views — from the legendary Hard Rock Guitar Hotel to endless beaches and turquoise waters also the Hard Rock Stadium from above.

* Pilots will share info and fun facts of every place we fly over

* Enjoy our private passenger room with free drinks and coffee

* Free private parking on site

See Miami like never before!
Come to fly with us!
